data.title: Strategy Booked an $8.3 Billion Bitcoin Loss Last Quarter. Could Q3 Show a Gain?
data.description: Strategy absorbed a staggering paper loss last quarter as Bitcoin slumped, but the cryptocurrency then staged a powerful rally that could flip the script entirely. Whether Q3 delivers a blockbuster reversal depends on one number investors are watching closely.
